about: A3 — 两个快照出口 snap.proj / snap.fever。'atk' 事件不够用：丰川祥子的音符自己飞（【自由移动】漂移 / 【追踪移动】，靠 A1 的 steer），没有攻击可以挂视觉、也没有目标视图可以追踪；服务端才是权威位置。fever 是刻意做成通用的：引擎不认识任何 kit 的计量条名字，只把 kit 写在 unit.mem.gauges 里的东西转发出去。dust 0.2.5 的 snapshot 已经有 elem/ammo/coins/wolves/neg/stand/standCut 一整块，所以两段新代码插在 `return snap;` 之前、并复用同一批局部声明风格（不改动既有字段）。

hunks.find:
*   elem: [[id, element, fill, cooldownEnd, cooldown]] — the element gauge each unit shows (damage.js elementView);
   *   ammo: [[id, rounds left, rounds in the magazine]] — a running ammo skill, whole rounds (snapshot.js ammoView): the segmented bar;

* ammo / wolves / neg / energy / layers / charges / stand / standCut are display only: no sim state reads them, and the
   * nine-field unit tuples are unchanged. bondTimers is also display only (golden canon excludes it).
hunks.replace:
* ammo / wolves / neg / energy / layers / charges / stand / standCut / proj / fever are display only: no sim state reads them, and the
   * nine-field unit tuples are unchanged. bondTimers is also display only (golden canon excludes it).
